question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'fortune'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The context of the concerned line is that women excel in every field and changed their life and future.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word is 'fortune'. 
 
• 'Fortune' means 'chance and the way it affects your life.'
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Nikhilesh changed his life and **fortune** after clearing the CGL exam.*​
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

​

Correct Sentence:__ ...*turning the tide of __**fortune**__ in their favour. *
